chunks.sanskrit: udu̠ ṣya de̠vaḥ sa̍vi̠tā hi̍ra̠ṇyayā̍ bā̠hū a̍yaṃsta̠ sava̍nāya su̠kratu̍: |
ghṛ̠tena̍ pā̠ṇī a̠bhi pru̍ṣṇute ma̠kho yuvā̍ su̠dakṣo̠ raja̍so̠ vidha̍rmaṇi || 1 ||
de̠vasya̍ va̠yaṃ sa̍vi̠tuḥ savī̍mani̠ śreṣṭhe̍ syāma̠ vasu̍naśca dā̠vane̍ |
yo viśva̍sya dvi̠pado̠ yaścatu̍ṣpado ni̠veśa̍ne prasa̠ve cāsi̠ bhūma̍naḥ || 2 ||
ada̍bdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pā̠yubhi̠ṣṭvaṃ śi̠vebhi̍ra̠dya pari̍ pāhi no̠ gaya̍m |
hira̍ṇyajihvaḥ suvi̠tāya̠ navya̍se̠ rakṣā̠ māki̍rno a̠ghaśaṃ̍sa īśata || 3 ||
udu̠ ṣya de̠vaḥ sa̍vi̠tā damū̍nā̠ hira̍ṇyapāṇiḥ pratido̠ṣama̍sthāt |
ayo̍hanuryaja̠to ma̠ndraji̍hva̠ ā dā̠śuṣe̍ suvati̠ bhūri̍ vā̠mam || 4 ||
udū̍ ayām̐ upava̠kteva̍ bā̠hū hi̍ra̠ṇyayā̍ savi̠tā su̠pratī̍kā |
di̠vo rohāṃ̍syaruhatpṛthi̠vyā arī̍ramatpa̠taya̠tkacci̠dabhva̍m || 5 ||
vā̠mama̠dya sa̍vitarvā̠mamu̠ śvo di̠vedi̍ve vā̠mama̠smabhyaṃ̍ sāvīḥ |
vā̠masya̠ hi kṣaya̍sya deva̠ bhūre̍ra̠yā dhi̠yā vā̍ma̠bhāja̍: syāma || 6 ||
indrā̍somā̠ mahi̠ tadvāṃ̍ mahi̠tvaṃ yu̠vaṃ ma̠hāni̍ pratha̠māni̍ cakrathuḥ |
yu̠vaṃ sūryaṃ̍ vivi̠dathu̍ryu̠vaṃ sva1rviśvā̠ tamāṃ̍syahataṃ ni̠daśca̍ || 1 ||
indrā̍somā vā̠saya̍tha u̠ṣāsa̠mutsūryaṃ̍ nayatho̠ jyoti̍ṣā sa̠ha |
upa̠ dyāṃ ska̠mbhathu̠: skambha̍ne̠nāpra̍thataṃ pṛthi̠vīṃ mā̠taraṃ̠ vi || 2 ||
indrā̍somā̠vahi̍ma̠paḥ pa̍ri̠ṣṭhāṃ ha̠tho vṛ̠tramanu̍ vāṃ̠ dyaura̍manyata |
prārṇāṃ̍syairayataṃ na̠dīnā̠mā sa̍mu̠drāṇi̍ paprathuḥ pu̠rūṇi̍ || 3 ||
indrā̍somā pa̠kvamā̠māsva̠ntarni gavā̠midda̍dhathurva̠kṣaṇā̍su |
ja̠gṛ̠bhathu̠rana̍pinaddhamāsu̠ ruśa̍cci̠trāsu̠ jaga̍tīṣva̠ntaḥ || 4 ||
indrā̍somā yu̠vama̠ṅga taru̍tramapatya̠sācaṃ̠ śrutyaṃ̍ rarāthe |
yu̠vaṃ śuṣmaṃ̠ naryaṃ̍ carṣa̠ṇibhya̠: saṃ vi̍vyathuḥ pṛtanā̠ṣāha̍mugrā || 5 ||
yo a̍dri̠bhitpra̍thama̠jā ṛ̠tāvā̠ bṛha̠spati̍rāṅgira̠so ha̠viṣmā̍n |
dvi̠barha̍jmā prāgharma̠satpi̠tā na̠ ā roda̍sī vṛṣa̠bho ro̍ravīti || 1 ||
janā̍ya ci̠dya īva̍ta u lo̠kaṃ bṛha̠spati̍rde̠vahū̍tau ca̠kāra̍ |
ghnanvṛ̠trāṇi̠ vi puro̍ dardarīti̠ jaya̠ñchatrūm̐̍ra̠mitrā̍npṛ̠tsu sāha̍n || 2 ||
bṛha̠spati̠: sama̍jaya̠dvasū̍ni ma̠ho vra̠jāngoma̍to de̠va e̠ṣaḥ |
a̠paḥ siṣā̍sa̠ntsva1rapra̍tīto̠ bṛha̠spati̠rhantya̠mitra̍ma̠rkaiḥ || 3 ||
somā̍rudrā dhā̠raye̍thāmasu̠ryaṃ1 pra vā̍mi̠ṣṭayo'ra̍maśnuvantu |
dame̍dame sa̠pta ratnā̠ dadhā̍nā̠ śaṃ no̍ bhūtaṃ dvi̠pade̠ śaṃ catu̍ṣpade || 1 ||
somā̍rudrā̠ vi vṛ̍hataṃ̠ viṣū̍cī̠mamī̍vā̠ yā no̠ gaya̍māvi̠veśa̍ |
ā̠re bā̍dhethāṃ̠ niṝ̍tiṃ parā̠caira̠sme bha̠drā sau̍śrava̠sāni̍ santu || 2 ||
somā̍rudrā yu̠vame̠tānya̠sme viśvā̍ ta̠nūṣu̍ bheṣa̠jāni̍ dhattam |
ava̍ syataṃ mu̠ñcataṃ̠ yanno̠ asti̍ ta̠nūṣu̍ ba̠ddhaṃ kṛ̠tameno̍ a̠smat || 3 ||
ti̠gmāyu̍dhau ti̠gmahe̍tī su̠śevau̠ somā̍rudrāvi̠ha su mṛ̍ḷataṃ naḥ |
pra no̍ muñcataṃ̠ varu̍ṇasya̠ pāśā̍dgopā̠yataṃ̍ naḥ sumana̠syamā̍nā || 4 ||
jī̠mūta̍syeva bhavati̠ pratī̍kaṃ̠ yadva̠rmī yāti̍ sa̠madā̍mu̠pasthe̍ |
anā̍viddhayā ta̠nvā̍ jaya̠ tvaṃ sa tvā̠ varma̍ṇo mahi̠mā pi̍partu || 1 ||
dhanva̍nā̠ gā dhanva̍nā̠jiṃ ja̍yema̠ dhanva̍nā tī̠vrāḥ sa̠mado̍ jayema |
dhanu̠: śatro̍rapakā̠maṃ kṛ̍ṇoti̠ dhanva̍nā̠ sarvā̍: pra̠diśo̍ jayema || 2 ||
va̠kṣyantī̠vedā ga̍nīganti̠ karṇaṃ̍ pri̠yaṃ sakhā̍yaṃ pariṣasvajā̠nā |
yoṣe̍va śiṅkte̠ vita̠tādhi̠ dhanva̠ñjyā i̠yaṃ sama̍ne pā̠raya̍ntī || 3 ||
te ā̠cara̍ntī̠ sama̍neva̠ yoṣā̍ mā̠teva̍ pu̠traṃ bi̍bhṛtāmu̠pasthe̍ |
apa̠ śatrū̍nvidhyatāṃ saṃvidā̠ne ārtnī̍ i̠me vi̍ṣphu̠rantī̍ a̠mitrā̍n || 4 ||
ba̠hvī̠nāṃ pi̠tā ba̠hura̍sya pu̠traści̠ścā kṛ̍ṇoti̠ sama̍nāva̠gatya̍ |
i̠ṣu̠dhiḥ saṅkā̠: pṛta̍nāśca̠ sarvā̍: pṛ̠ṣṭhe nina̍ddho jayati̠ prasū̍taḥ || 5 ||
rathe̠ tiṣṭha̍nnayati vā̠jina̍: pu̠ro yatra̍yatra kā̠maya̍te suṣāra̠thiḥ |
a̠bhīśū̍nāṃ mahi̠mānaṃ̍ panāyata̠ mana̍: pa̠ścādanu̍ yacchanti ra̠śmaya̍: || 6 ||
tī̠vrānghoṣā̍nkṛṇvate̠ vṛṣa̍pāṇa̠yo'śvā̠ rathe̍bhiḥ sa̠ha vā̠jaya̍ntaḥ |
a̠va̠krāma̍nta̠: prapa̍daira̠mitrā̍nkṣi̠ṇanti̠ śatrūm̠̐rana̍pavyayantaḥ || 7 ||
ra̠tha̠vāha̍naṃ ha̠vira̍sya̠ nāma̠ yatrāyu̍dhaṃ̠ nihi̍tamasya̠ varma̍ |
tatrā̠ ratha̠mupa̍ śa̠gmaṃ sa̍dema vi̠śvāhā̍ va̠yaṃ su̍mana̠syamā̍nāḥ || 8 ||
svā̠du̠ṣaṃ̠sada̍: pi̠taro̍ vayo̠dhāḥ kṛ̍cchre̠śrita̠: śaktī̍vanto gabhī̠rāḥ |
ci̠trase̍nā̠ iṣu̍balā̠ amṛ̍dhrāḥ sa̠tovī̍rā u̠ravo̍ vrātasā̠hāḥ || 9 ||
brāhma̍ṇāsa̠: pita̍ra̠: somyā̍saḥ śi̠ve no̠ dyāvā̍pṛthi̠vī a̍ne̠hasā̍ |
pū̠ṣā na̍: pātu duri̠tādṛ̍tāvṛdho̠ rakṣā̠ māki̍rno a̠ghaśaṃ̍sa īśata || 10 ||
su̠pa̠rṇaṃ va̍ste mṛ̠go a̍syā̠ danto̠ gobhi̠: saṃna̍ddhā patati̠ prasū̍tā |
yatrā̠ nara̠: saṃ ca̠ vi ca̠ drava̍nti̠ tatrā̠smabhya̠miṣa̍va̠: śarma̍ yaṃsan || 11 ||
ṛjī̍te̠ pari̍ vṛṅdhi̠ no'śmā̍ bhavatu nasta̠nūḥ |
somo̠ adhi̍ bravītu̠ no'di̍ti̠: śarma̍ yacchatu || 12 ||
ā ja̍ṅghanti̠ sānve̍ṣāṃ ja̠ghanām̠̐ upa̍ jighnate |
aśvā̍jani̠ prace̍ta̠so'śvā̍ntsa̠matsu̍ codaya || 13 ||
ahi̍riva bho̠gaiḥ parye̍ti bā̠huṃ jyāyā̍ he̠tiṃ pa̍ri̠bādha̍mānaḥ |
ha̠sta̠ghno viśvā̍ va̠yunā̍ni vi̠dvānpumā̠npumāṃ̍saṃ̠ pari̍ pātu vi̠śvata̍: || 14 ||
ālā̍ktā̠ yā ruru̍śī̠rṣṇyatho̠ yasyā̠ ayo̠ mukha̍m |
i̠daṃ pa̠rjanya̍retasa̠ iṣvai̍ de̠vyai bṛ̠hannama̍: || 15 ||
ava̍sṛṣṭā̠ parā̍ pata̠ śara̍vye̠ brahma̍saṃśite |
gacchā̠mitrā̠npra pa̍dyasva̠ māmīṣāṃ̠ kaṃ ca̠nocchi̍ṣaḥ || 16 ||
yatra̍ bā̠ṇāḥ sa̠mpata̍nti kumā̠rā vi̍śi̠khā i̍va |
tatrā̍ no̠ brahma̍ṇa̠spati̠radi̍ti̠: śarma̍ yacchatu vi̠śvāhā̠ śarma̍ yacchatu || 17 ||
marmā̍ṇi te̠ varma̍ṇā chādayāmi̠ soma̍stvā̠ rājā̠mṛte̠nānu̍ vastām |
u̠rorvarī̍yo̠ varu̍ṇaste kṛṇotu̠ jaya̍ntaṃ̠ tvānu̍ de̠vā ma̍dantu || 18 ||
yo na̠: svo ara̍ṇo̠ yaśca̠ niṣṭyo̠ jighāṃ̍sati |
de̠vāstaṃ sarve̍ dhūrvantu̠ brahma̠ varma̠ mamānta̍ram || 19 ||
